titre_page: How do I cut a sprite sheet into animations? | Yop2D guide
description: In Yop2D, the "Sheet" button cuts a sprite sheet (columns and rows) and creates the animations for you, one per row or by picking the pictures by hand.
h1: Cutting a sprite sheet into animations
carte: One picture cut into ready-made animations.
etapes: Tell Yop2D the columns and rows.
One animation per row, then "Create N animations".
blocs: Many characters come on **a single sheet**: all the walking or jumping pictures side by side, in rows. Yop2D **cuts** it up and makes the **animations** for you, so you don't have to save each picture.
a project open in the editor;
a sprite sheet (PNG) whose cells are all the same size.
Open the **Assets** window and tap the **Sheet** button.
Pick your picture in the library. To use another one later: **Change image**.

Answer **How many pictures in the sheet?**: the number of **columns** and **rows** (− and + buttons, or type the number). Yop2D suggests a number and tells you it guessed: **count on your sheet and fix it if needed**. The grid must fall exactly between the pictures.
A file name like "16x16" helps Yop2D guess the size of a cell.

**One animation per row** (suggested when there are several rows): each row becomes an animation. Yop2D suggests names; tap ✎ to change them. With 4 rows it suggests walk_down, walk_left, walk_right, walk_up: these names are recognized by behaviors, so the animation plays by itself.

**Pick the pictures by hand**: for an animation that spans several rows. Tap **New animation** if needed, pick the animation in the list, then tap the first picture on the sheet and slide to the last one.
**Skip empty cells**: skips the empty cells of the sheet (ticked automatically if there are some).
Watch the **Preview**: it moves, so you can check the pictures flow well. The **Preview speed** setting only changes this preview.
The game's speed is set in the [[jouer_animation]] node (frames per second), not in the preview.
The pictures are stored in **Images**, in a folder named after the sheet, and the animations appear in the animation list. Then use the [[jouer_animation]] node to play them.
